## Books Project

A job the books track income and costs by: `projectId`, `name`, `customerId`, `status` (active, completed or canceled), and `project`, a link to the projects cluster's card for the work itself.

```ts
import { BooksProject } from '@cardstack/catalog/cards/accounting/ledger-dimensions';
```

A posting line names it in `project`, beside its class (`cls`, the channel or department): sale, bill and journal lines carry it, and the posted lines keep it. Time activities name it in `projectId`.

### Non-goals
No budgets or estimates by project.

### Example
`BooksProject/PRJ-ATLAS-CUPPING`, a cupping program for Atlas.
